correctness.rationale: Conditionally on the recursively reinforced forest, each component carries one independent fair bit; the parity character E(-1)^S is exactly the indicator all components have even cardinality. Odd N cannot satisfy it. With Nq_N -> lambda, edge deletions form a Poisson(lambda) family of uniformly chosen recursive-tree labels. Nested cut pairs occur with probability O(q_N^2 N log N)=o(1); a typical cut fringe has size k with probability 1/[k(k+1)], and Poisson marking gives independent mean lambda/[k(k+1)] size counts. The odd-size mass sum_{j>=1}1/((2j-1)(2j))=log 2 yields bias e^{-lambda log2}; TV is half the bias. The supercritical Nq_N->infinity conclusion uses the specified Peres–Qin upper bound b_N<=alpha_N^(N/2)<=e^{-Nq_N/2}. Independently reconstructed exact step-count recursion at alpha=3/4 gives even N=4,6,8 biases 33/64,45/128,27423/114688; these finite checks support normalization but do not prove the Poisson limit.
